title: BS Ancient Settings
description: These options are written to bs_ancient_config.cfg. Changes require restarting the game and starting a new run to take effect.
sections.ancients.title: Ancients
onlyUseModAncients.title: Only Spawn Mod Ancients
onlyUseModAncients.description: When enabled, Act 2 will only choose from Node/Mabel, and Act 3 will only choose from Prickett/Mabel. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
disableModAncients.title: Disable Mod Map Ancients
disableModAncients.description: When enabled, Node, Prickett, and Mabel will not appear on the map. This takes priority over "Only Spawn Mod Ancients". Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
replaceNeowAppearance.title: Replace Neow Appearance
replaceNeowAppearance.description: When enabled, replaces starting Neow's appearance, name, title, and related dialogue with Grand Guignol. Requires restarting the game.
grandGuignolInitialRelicChance.title: Grand Guignol Initial Relic Chance
grandGuignolInitialRelicChance.descripti: Controls the chance for a starting positive option to be replaced by Grand Guignol's initial relic. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
